pairsWith.noteUz: a/an qoidasi grammar 4-betdagi nazariya bilan bir xil, mashqlari esa grammar 7-bet Ex.11 ga mos keladi.

rule.explanationUz: a/an — 'bitta, qandaydir' ma'nosini beradi. O'zbek tilida bunday so'z YO'Q, shuning uchun uni tushirib qoldirish eng ko'p uchraydigan xato: 'He is teacher' — XATO, 'He is A teacher' — to'g'ri.

rules.enRule: We use a/an before singular nouns.
We use a before consonant sounds (b, c, d, f, etc).
We use an before vowel sounds (a, e, i, o, u).

rule.warningUz:
Qoida HARFGA emas, TOVUSHGA bog'liq:
• an hour — 'h' o'qilmaydi → unli tovush → an
• a university — 'yu' deb o'qiladi → undosh tovush → a
• an engineer — 'e' unli → an
rule.pluralNoteUz: Ko'plikda a/an YO'Q: 'They are doctors' (a doctors emas).

exercises.instructionEn: Add a or an to the words in the list, then label the pictures. Finally, in pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarga a yoki an qo'shing, so'ng rasmlarni belgilang. Nihoyat, juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikki bosqichli mashq:
1) Har kasbga a yoki an tanlang (birinchi TOVUSHGA qarang).
2) Rasmdagi odamning ismi va yoshi berilgan — ular haqida savol-javob tuzing.
Diqqat: artist, astronaut, engineer — unli tovush bilan boshlanadi → an.

items.name: Helen
items.noteUz: Helen — ayol, shuning uchun savolda 'her': What's HER job?

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue, then listen and fill in the missing words. In pairs, read out the dialogue.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing, so'ng eshitib yetishmayotgan so'zlarni to'ldiring. Juftlikda o'qib chiqing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu — bazmda tanishuv suhbati. Barcha yetishmayotgan so'zlar SO'ROQ SO'ZLARI:
• What's your name? — ism
• Where are you from? — joy
• What's your job? — kasb
• How old are you? — yosh
Shu 4 ta savol tanishuvning asosi.

lines.en: I'm Alison, by the way. 1) ___ your name?
I'm Steve, Steve Blair. Nice to meet you.
lines.uz: Men Steve, Steve Blair. Tanishganimdan xursandman.

lines.en: Nice to meet you, too. 2) ___ are you from?

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogue and repeat it. In pairs, use your names to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni eshiting va takrorlang. Juftlikda o'z ismingiz bilan shunga o'xshash dialog tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Qo'shni bilan tanishish dialogi. Yangi iboralar:
• Excuse me — kechirasiz (murojaat qilishda)
• Are you ...? — siz ...misiz? (ismni aniqlash)
• I'm your new neighbour — men sizning yangi qo'shningizman
Ism ikki marta aytiladi: 'Tony, Tony Brown' — avval qisqa, keyin to'liq.

lines.en: Excuse me. Are you Rita Brian?
Hi. I'm your new neighbour, Tony, Tony Brown.
lines.uz: Salom. Men sizning yangi qo'shningizman, Tony, Tony Brown.

lines.en: Oh, hello, Tony. Nice to meet you.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to this dialogue and put it into the correct order.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu dialogni eshiting va to'g'ri tartibda joylashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Uchinchi shaxsni tanishtirish qolipi:
'X, this is Y.' — X ga Y ni tanishtiryapsiz.
Javob: 'Pleased to meet you.' → 'Pleased to meet you, too.'
Mantiq: avval salomlashish, keyin tanishtirish, keyin ikki tomonlama javob.

items.en: Hello, Patrick. Patrick, this is Lucy. She's my friend from America.
items.uz: Salom, Patrick. Patrick, bu Lucy. U mening Amerikadan kelgan do'stim.

exercises.correctSequenceUz: 1) Jane salomlashadi va Lucy'ni tanishtiradi → 2) Patrick Jane'ga javob beradi → 3) Patrick Lucy bilan tanishadi → 4) Lucy javob qaytaradi.

wordFormation.introUz: Ex. 15 dagi 8 ta kasb — deyarli hammasi qo'shimcha bilan yasalgan. Artikl tanlashda birinchi tovushga qarang.

groups.explanationUz: Ish yoki joydan uni bajaruvchi yasaladi.
San'at va fan sohalarida. Ikkalasi ham unli bilan boshlanadi → an.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Tanishuvning 5 ta asosiy qolipi — bularni yodlab olsangiz, har qanday tanishuvni olib chiqasiz.

patterns.exampleEn: I'm Alison, by the way. What's your name?
patterns.explanationUz: Ism oldidan a/an QO'YILMAYDI. 'by the way' — mavzuni o'zgartirganda ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: Where are you from? → I'm from + JOY.
patterns.exampleEn: Where are you from? — I'm from Scotland.
patterns.explanationUz: 'from' savolda oxirida, javobda esa joydan oldin keladi.

patterns.formula: What's your job? → I'm + a/an + KASB.
patterns.exampleEn: What's your job? — I'm a doctor.
Patrick, this is Lucy. She's my friend from America.
patterns.exampleUz: Patrick, bu Lucy. U mening Amerikadan kelgan do'stim.
patterns.explanationUz: Uchinchi shaxsni tanishtirish qolipi. 'This is' — odam uchun ham ishlatiladi (bu yerda 'bu kishi' ma'nosida).

patterns.formula: Nice / Pleased to meet you. → ... , too.
patterns.exampleEn: Pleased to meet you, Lucy. — Pleased to meet you, too.
patterns.explanationUz: Javobda 'too' qo'shiladi — 'men ham' ma'nosida. 'Nice to meet you' va 'Pleased to meet you' bir xil ma'no.
